subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: make the whole story. Only the corresponding numbers of the sentences need to be written. 18 = 8 (a) Special food is prepared and clothes are made on this occasion. (b) These two words together mean 'people belonging to the east.' (c) One of the festivities is the celebration of New Year. (d) The Sherpas are mountain people. (e) The Sherpas celebrate different festivals around the year. (f) It is situated in front of Mt. Everest. (g) The word 'Sherpa' is derived from the two words 'Shar' and 'Wa'. (h) They live in three levels of the mountain range in Nepal.  Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
